Messages.Author: Lasu
Messages.Body:
Can I choose the order in which my uncontrolled vampires become
controlled?
I mean, if my predator has Sonja Blue and I want to influence out two
more copies of her, does my first copy and my predators copy get
removed from game before my second copy enters play?

//Lasu

Messages.Author: Pat
Messages.Body:
"Lasu" <lasse...@elisanet.fi> wrote in message
news:1168515943.0...@p59g2000hsd.googlegroups.com...

> Can I choose the order in which my uncontrolled vampires become
> controlled?

I don't believe you can. Per the rulebook, "**at the end** of your influence
phase, any vampire in your uncontrolled region with a number of blood
counters on him equal to (or more than) his capacity becomes controlled."

I believe they're all considered to come out at the same time, just like all
your cards are considered to simultaneously untap at the beginning of your
untap phase.

> I mean, if my predator has Sonja Blue and I want to influence out two
> more copies of her, does my first copy and my predators copy get
> removed from game before my second copy enters play?

I don't think so. I believe all would be removed from the game, after you
gain 4 pool for each of the copies you influenced. (Per the ruling here:
http://groups-beta.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/1f2af31f127a0ad5)

- Pat

Pat wrote:
> "Lasu" <lasse...@elisanet.fi> wrote in message
> news:1168515943.0...@p59g2000hsd.googlegroups.com...
>> Can I choose the order in which my uncontrolled vampires become
>> controlled?
>
> I don't believe you can. Per the rulebook, "**at the end** of your influence
> phase, any vampire in your uncontrolled region with a number of blood
> counters on him equal to (or more than) his capacity becomes controlled."
>
> I believe they're all considered to come out at the same time, just like all
> your cards are considered to simultaneously untap at the beginning of your
> untap phase.

They come out in the same window (at the end of the influence phase), but they
come out one by one.

This also matters for scarce vampires (bring out two from the same clan at the
"same time" and the second still costs you 3 pool for the first) and for Jimmy
Dunn (bring out two at the same time and the second burns the first).

http://groups.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/950b919b4ac941c2

>> I mean, if my predator has Sonja Blue and I want to influence out two
>> more copies of her, does my first copy and my predators copy get
>> removed from game before my second copy enters play?
>
> I don't think so. I believe all would be removed from the game, after you
> gain 4 pool for each of the copies you influenced. (Per the ruling here:
> http://groups-beta.google.com/group/rec.games.trading-cards.jyhad/msg/1f2af31f127a0ad5)

It works. The first contests (removing both the first and the one it was
contesting) then the second comes into play as normal.
